brief.headline: Pay you 15 days faster in exchange for a price cut of about 4.38% — the rate you pay to borrow money

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹290.00/KG on the three biggest SKUs — the price we already pay Shrinath Roto Pack — and save ₹32.69 L/year
priceAsk.target: ₹290.00/KG (the price Shrinath Roto Pack charges us)
priceAsk.basis: We're paying ₹294.03/KG to ₹308.30/KG to GEEP when we already get the same material at ₹290.00/KG. The open market for pharma ORS sachet laminate runs ₹205–305/kg, so ₹290 sits comfortably inside that band and is fair.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days after receipt (instead of 30 days) if they cut price by roughly 4.38%
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster ties up ₹1.16 Cr of our cash, so we need a price cut worth at least that much to make it a win for us.

brief.financialLeverage: They're financially stable (safe zone on distress, 3.35 Altman-Z) but cash-tight: their cash is stuck for 81 days versus 46 days at similar firms, and they keep only 1.1% as profit. We're 9.72% of their ₹291.36 Cr revenue — a big customer. They borrow money at rates between 1.55% and 9.25%, so paying them faster has real value to them. Push on payment terms and the ₹32.69 L price gap, but don't squeeze so hard on margin that we hurt supply — there's only 1.1% profit to spare.

evidence.point: We pay ₹32.69 L/year more than the best price we already get
Their cash is stuck for 81 days, much longer than similar firms at 46 days
We are 9.72% of everything they sell
They keep only 1.1% as profit on every ₹100 of sales
They borrow at rates ranging from 1.55% to 9.25%
Paying them 15 days faster ties up ₹1.16 Cr of our cash

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter, already supplies FDC in small volumes, can scale up laminate sachets as a proven second source

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant that makes both film substrate and converts it — can second-source GEEP at scale

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Global group's India converter doing pharma blister and sachet laminates, strong fit but weaker finances (D rating, 31/100)

risks: They're our main source for Laminates — 76% of what we buy — so pushing too hard could disrupt supply; line up and qualify a second source first
Rating is CRISIL BB+ / Stable but the agency says the company stopped sharing info, so the numbers may be stale — treat their health as uncertain
They have GST filing delays, EPF payment delays, and pending legal cases — watch for any operational hiccups
Only 1.1% profit margin leaves almost no room for a big price cut without hurting them — win on payment terms and the ₹32.69 L gap, not a deeper squeeze
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: You're a key partner — 9.72% of your sales — and we'd like to align our pricing with the ₹290/kg we pay others and offer faster payment in return.
